WITH "tx2021" AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "block_timestamp_month") AS "month_start",
    "hash",
    "is_coinbase",
    "inputs",
    "outputs"
  FROM CRYPTO.CRYPTO_BITCOIN.TRANSACTIONS
  WHERE "block_timestamp_month" >= DATE '2021-01-01'
    AND "block_timestamp_month" < DATE '2022-01-01'
),
"input_stats" AS (
  SELECT
    t."hash",
    SUM(IFF(i.value:"spent_transaction_hash"::STRING IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) AS "input_utxo_count",
    SUM(IFF(i.value:"spent_transaction_hash"::STRING IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(TRY_TO_NUMBER(i.value:"value"::STRING), 0), 0)) AS "input_value"
  FROM "tx2021" t,
    LATERAL FLATTEN(input => t."inputs") i
  GROUP BY t."hash"
),
"output_value_counts" AS (
  SELECT
    t."hash",
    TRY_TO_NUMBER(o.value:"value"::STRING) AS "utxo_value",
    COUNT(*) AS "output_value_occurrences"
  FROM "tx2021" t,
    LATERAL FLATTEN(input => t."outputs") o
  WHERE TRY_TO_NUMBER(o.value:"value"::STRING) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t."hash", TRY_TO_NUMBER(o.value:"value"::STRING)
),
"output_stats" AS (
  SELECT
    "hash",
    SUM("output_value_occurrences") AS "output_utxo_count",
    SUM("utxo_value" * "output_value_occurrences") AS "output_value",
    MAX(IFF("output_value_occurrences" >= 2, 1, 0)) AS "has_equal_value_outputs"
  FROM "output_value_counts"
  GROUP BY "hash"
),
"classified_transactions" AS (
  SELECT
    t."month_start",
    t."hash",
    COALESCE(i."input_utxo_count", 0) AS "input_utxo_count",
    COALESCE(o."output_utxo_count", 0) AS "output_utxo_count",
    COALESCE(i."input_value", 0) AS "input_value",
    COALESCE(o."output_value", 0) AS "output_value",
    IFF(
      COALESCE(t."is_coinbase", FALSE) = FALSE
      AND COALESCE(o."output_utxo_count", 0) > 2
      AND COALESCE(o."output_value", 0) <= COALESCE(i."input_value", 0)
      AND COALESCE(o."has_equal_value_outputs", 0) = 1,
      TRUE,
      FALSE
    ) AS "is_coinjoin"
  FROM "tx2021" t
  LEFT JOIN "input_stats" i
    ON t."hash" = i."hash"
  LEFT JOIN "output_stats" o
    ON t."hash" = o."hash"
),
"monthly_metrics" AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "month_start") AS "month",
    COUNT(*) AS "all_transaction_count",
    SUM(IFF("is_coinjoin", 1, 0)) AS "coinjoin_transaction_count",
    SUM("output_value") AS "total_volume",
    SUM(IFF("is_coinjoin", "output_value", 0)) AS "coinjoin_volume",
    SUM("input_utxo_count") AS "all_input_utxo_count",
    SUM(IFF("is_coinjoin", "input_utxo_count", 0)) AS "coinjoin_input_utxo_count",
    SUM("output_utxo_count") AS "all_output_utxo_count",
    SUM(IFF("is_coinjoin", "output_utxo_count", 0)) AS "coinjoin_output_utxo_count"
  FROM "classified_transactions"
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "month_start")
),
"monthly_percentages" AS (
  SELECT
    "month",
    ROUND(100 * "coinjoin_transaction_count" / NULLIF("all_transaction_count", 0), 1) AS "coinjoin_transaction_percentage",
    ROUND(
      (
        (100 * "coinjoin_input_utxo_count" / NULLIF("all_input_utxo_count", 0))
        + (100 * "coinjoin_output_utxo_count" / NULLIF("all_output_utxo_count", 0))
      ) / 2,
      1
    ) AS "coinjoin_utxo_percentage",
    ROUND(100 * "coinjoin_volume" / NULLIF("total_volume", 0), 1) AS "coinjoin_volume_percentage",
    100 * "coinjoin_volume" / NULLIF("total_volume", 0) AS "coinjoin_volume_percentage_unrounded"
  FROM "monthly_metrics"
)
SELECT
  "month",
  "coinjoin_transaction_percentage",
  "coinjoin_utxo_percentage",
  "coinjoin_volume_percentage"
FROM "monthly_percentages"
ORDER BY "coinjoin_volume_percentage_unrounded" DESC NULLS LAST, "month" ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH "user_cohort" AS (
  SELECT
    "id" AS "user_id",
    "reputation",
    TO_TIMESTAMP("creation_date" / 1000000)::DATE AS "join_date",
    DATEDIFF('YEAR', TO_TIMESTAMP("creation_date" / 1000000)::DATE, DATE '2021-10-01')
      - IFF(
          DATEADD('YEAR', DATEDIFF('YEAR', TO_TIMESTAMP("creation_date" / 1000000)::DATE, DATE '2021-10-01'), TO_TIMESTAMP("creation_date" / 1000000)::DATE) > DATE '2021-10-01',
          1,
          0
        ) AS "complete_years_member"
  FROM STACKOVERFLOW.STACKOVERFLOW.USERS
  WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP("creation_date" / 1000000)::DATE <= DATE '2021-10-01'
),
"badge_counts" AS (
  SELECT
    "user_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "badge_count"
  FROM STACKOVERFLOW.STACKOVERFLOW.BADGES
  GROUP BY "user_id"
)
SELECT
  uc."complete_years_member",
  COUNT(*) AS "user_count",
  ROUND(AVG(uc."reputation"), 4) AS "average_reputation",
  SUM(COALESCE(bc."badge_count", 0)) AS "number_of_badges",
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(bc."badge_count", 0)), 4) AS "average_badges_per_user"
FROM "user_cohort" uc
LEFT JOIN "badge_counts" bc
  ON uc."user_id" = bc."user_id"

WITH "months_2020" AS (
    SELECT TO_DATE("v"."month_start") AS "month_start"
    FROM (VALUES
        ('2020-01-01'),
        ('2020-02-01'),
        ('2020-03-01'),
        ('2020-04-01'),
        ('2020-05-01'),
        ('2020-06-01'),
        ('2020-07-01'),
        ('2020-08-01'),
        ('2020-09-01'),
        ('2020-10-01'),
        ('2020-11-01'),
        ('2020-12-01')
    ) AS "v"("month_start")
),
"customers" AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        "customer_id"
    FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS"
    WHERE "customer_id" IS NOT NULL
),
"parsed_transactions" AS (
    SELECT
        "customer_id",
        COALESCE(
            TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYYMMDD'),
            TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date", 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
            TRY_TO_DATE("txn_date")
        ) AS "transaction_date",
        LOWER(TRIM("txn_type")) AS "txn_type",
        "txn_amount"
    FROM "BANK_SALES_TRADING"."BANK_SALES_TRADING"."CUSTOMER_TRANSACTIONS"
    WHERE "customer_id" IS NOT NULL
),
"customer_month_activity" AS (
    SELECT
        "customer_id",
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "transaction_date")::DATE AS "month_start",
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN "txn_type" = 'deposit' THEN "txn_amount"
                WHEN "txn_type" LIKE 'withdraw%' THEN -"txn_amount"
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS "month_end_balance"
    FROM "parsed_transactions"
    WHERE "transaction_date" >= DATE '2020-01-01'
      AND "transaction_date" < DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND ("txn_type" = 'deposit' OR "txn_type" LIKE 'withdraw%')
    GROUP BY
        "customer_id",
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "transaction_date")::DATE
),
"customer_month_balances" AS (
    SELECT
        "c"."customer_id",
        "m"."month_start",
        COALESCE("a"."month_end_balance", 0) AS "month_end_balance"
    FROM "customers" AS "c"
    CROSS JOIN "months_2020" AS "m"
    LEFT JOIN "customer_month_activity" AS "a"
        ON "c"."customer_id" = "a"."customer_id"
       AND "m"."month_start" = "a"."month_start"
),
"monthly_summary" AS (
    SELECT
        "month_start",
        COUNT_IF("month_end_balance" > 0) AS "positive_balance_customer_count",
        AVG("month_end_balance") AS "average_month_end_balance"
    FROM "customer_month_balances"
    GROUP BY "month_start"
),
"ranked_months" AS (
    SELECT
        "month_start",
        "positive_balance_customer_count",
        "average_month_end_balance",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "positive_balance_customer_count" DESC, "month_start" ASC) AS "highest_rank",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "positive_balance_customer_count" ASC, "month_start" ASC) AS "lowest_rank"
    FROM "monthly_summary"
),
"selected_months" AS (
    SELECT
        'highest_positive_balance_customer_count' AS "selected_month_type",
        1 AS "selection_order",
        "month_start",
        "positive_balance_customer_count",
        "average_month_end_balance"
    FROM "ranked_months"
    WHERE "highest_rank" = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'lowest_positive_balance_customer_count' AS "selected_month_type",
        2 AS "selection_order",
        "month_start",
        "positive_balance_customer_count",
        "average_month_end_balance"
    FROM "ranked_months"
    WHERE "lowest_rank" = 1
),
"average_difference" AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN "selected_month_type" = 'highest_positive_balance_customer_count' THEN "average_month_end_balance" END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN "selected_month_type" = 'lowest_positive_balance_customer_count' THEN "average_month_end_balance" END) AS "average_balance_difference"
    FROM "selected_months"
)
SELECT
    "s"."selected_month_type",
    "s"."month_start",
    "s"."positive_balance_customer_count",
    ROUND("s"."average_month_end_balance", 4) AS "average_month_end_balance",
    ROUND("d"."average_balance_difference", 4) AS "average_balance_difference"
FROM "selected_months" AS "s"
CROSS JOIN "average_difference" AS "d"
ORDER BY "s"."selection_order" ASC;

WITH "years" ("year") AS (
    SELECT 2021 UNION ALL
    SELECT 2022 UNION ALL
    SELECT 2023
),
"months" ("month_num", "month") AS (
    SELECT 4, 'April' UNION ALL
    SELECT 5, 'May' UNION ALL
    SELECT 6, 'June'
),
"year_months" AS (
    SELECT
        "years"."year",
        "months"."month_num",
        "months"."month"
    FROM "years"
    CROSS JOIN "months"
),
"monthly_counts" AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR("insert_date", 1, 4)) AS "year",
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR("insert_date", 5, 2)) AS "month_num",
        COUNT(*) AS "monthly_cities_added"
    FROM CITY_LEGISLATION.CITY_LEGISLATION.CITIES
    WHERE "insert_date" >= '20210401'
      AND "insert_date" < '20230701'
      AND SUBSTR("insert_date", 5, 2) IN ('04', '05', '06')
    GROUP BY
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR("insert_date", 1, 4)),
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR("insert_date", 5, 2))
),
"filled_counts" AS (
    SELECT
        "year_months"."year",
        "year_months"."month_num",
        "year_months"."month",
        COALESCE("monthly_counts"."monthly_cities_added", 0) AS "monthly_cities_added"
    FROM "year_months"
    LEFT JOIN "monthly_counts"
        ON "year_months"."year" = "monthly_counts"."year"
       AND "year_months"."month_num" = "monthly_counts"."month_num"
),
"running_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        "year",
        "month_num",
        "month",
        "monthly_cities_added",
        SUM("monthly_cities_added") OVER (
            PARTITION BY "month_num"
            ORDER BY "year"
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS "cumulative_running_total"
    FROM "filled_counts"
),
"yoy" AS (
    SELECT
        "year",
        "month_num",
        "month",
        "monthly_cities_added",
        "cumulative_running_total",
        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN LAG("monthly_cities_added") OVER (PARTITION BY "month_num" ORDER BY "year") IS NULL
                  OR LAG("monthly_cities_added") OVER (PARTITION BY "month_num" ORDER BY "year") = 0
                THEN NULL
                ELSE (
                    ("monthly_cities_added" - LAG("monthly_cities_added") OVER (PARTITION BY "month_num" ORDER BY "year"))
                    / LAG("monthly_cities_added") OVER (PARTITION BY "month_num" ORDER BY "year")
                ) * 100
            END,
            4
        ) AS "monthly_yoy_growth_percentage",
        ROUND(
            CASE
                WHEN LAG("cumulative_running_total") OVER (PARTITION BY "month_num" ORDER BY "year") IS NULL
                  OR LAG("cumulative_running_total") OVER (PARTITION BY "month_num" ORDER BY "year") = 0
                THEN NULL
                ELSE (
                    ("cumulative_running_total" - LAG("cumulative_running_total") OVER (PARTITION BY "month_num" ORDER BY "year"))
                    / LAG("cumulative_running_total") OVER (PARTITION BY "month_num" ORDER BY "year")
                ) * 100
            END,
            4
        ) AS "running_total_yoy_growth_percentage"
    FROM "running_totals"
)
SELECT
    "year",
    "month",
    "monthly_cities_added",
    "cumulative_running_total",
    "monthly_yoy_growth_percentage",
    "running_total_yoy_growth_percentage"
FROM "yoy"
WHERE "year" IN (2022, 2023)

  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

  SELECT
    i."drg_definition",

  FROM CMS_DATA.CMS_MEDICARE.INPATIENT_CHARGES_2014 i

    ON i."drg_definition" = d."drg_definition"

    i."drg_definition",
    i."provider_city"

  SELECT
    "drg_definition",

  LEFT JOIN "zip_fallbacks" zf
    ON t."boroname" = zf."boroname"
   AND COALESCE(t."nta_name", '') = COALESCE(zf."nta_name", '')
),
"joined_trees_income" AS (
  SELECT
    tf."tree_id",

WITH "product_dim" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        MAX("prod_name") AS "prod_name"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PRODUCTS
    GROUP BY "prod_id"
),
"us_customer_rows" AS (
    SELECT
        "cust_src_id",
        COALESCE(
            TO_VARCHAR("cust_city_id"),
            UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("cust_state_province", ''))) || '|' || UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("cust_city", '')))
        ) AS "city_key"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.CUSTOMERS
    WHERE TRIM(UPPER(COALESCE("cust_state_province", ''))) IN (
        'AL','AK','AZ','AR','CA','CO','CT','DE','DC','FL','GA','HI','ID','IL','IN','IA','KS','KY','LA','ME',
        'MD','MA','MI','MN','MS','MO','MT','NE','NV','NH','NJ','NM','NY','NC','ND','OH','OK','OR','PA','RI',
        'SC','SD','TN','TX','UT','VT','VA','WA','WV','WI','WY',
        'ALABAMA','ALASKA','ARIZONA','ARKANSAS','CALIFORNIA','COLORADO','CONNECTICUT','DELAWARE',
        'DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA','FLORIDA','GEORGIA','HAWAII','IDAHO','ILLINOIS','INDIANA','IOWA',
        'KANSAS','KENTUCKY','LOUISIANA','MAINE','MARYLAND','MASSACHUSETTS','MICHIGAN','MINNESOTA',
        'MISSISSIPPI','MISSOURI','MONTANA','NEBRASKA','NEVADA','NEW HAMPSHIRE','NEW JERSEY',
        'NEW MEXICO','NEW YORK','NORTH CAROLINA','NORTH DAKOTA','OHIO','OKLAHOMA','OREGON',
        'PENNSYLVANIA','RHODE ISLAND','SOUTH CAROLINA','SOUTH DAKOTA','TENNESSEE','TEXAS','UTAH',
        'VERMONT','VIRGINIA','WASHINGTON','WEST VIRGINIA','WISCONSIN','WYOMING',
        'US','USA','UNITED STATES','UNITED STATES OF AMERICA'
    )
    OR TRIM(UPPER(COALESCE("cust_total", ''))) IN ('US','USA','UNITED STATES','UNITED STATES OF AMERICA')
),
"customer_id_candidates" AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(TRIM("cust_src_id")) AS "cust_id",
        "city_key",
        1 AS "priority"
    FROM "us_customer_rows"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR("cust_src_id", '[0-9]+')) AS "cust_id",
        "city_key",
        2 AS "priority"
    FROM "us_customer_rows"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_REPLACE("cust_src_id", '[^0-9]', '')) AS "cust_id",
        "city_key",
        3 AS "priority"
    FROM "us_customer_rows"
),
"us_customers" AS (
    SELECT
        "cust_id",
        "city_key"
    FROM "customer_id_candidates"
    WHERE "cust_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "city_key" IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "cust_id"
        ORDER BY "priority" ASC, "city_key" ASC
    ) = 1
),
"base_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        uc."city_key",
        s."prod_id",
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE(s."time_id", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "quarter_start",
        s."amount_sold" AS "amount_sold"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s
    JOIN "us_customers" uc
        ON s."cust_id" = uc."cust_id"
    LEFT JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PROMOTIONS pr
        ON s."promo_id" = pr."promo_id"
    WHERE (
            s."time_id" BETWEEN '20191001' AND '20191231'
         OR s."time_id" BETWEEN '20201001' AND '20201231'
    )
      AND (
            s."promo_id" IS NULL
         OR s."promo_id" IN (0, 999)
         OR UPPER(COALESCE(pr."promo_name", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROM%'
         OR UPPER(COALESCE(pr."promo_subcategory", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROM%'
         OR UPPER(COALESCE(pr."promo_category", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROM%'
         OR UPPER(COALESCE(pr."promo_total", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROM%'
      )
),
"city_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "city_key",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "amount_sold" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2019_sales",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN "amount_sold" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2020_sales"
    FROM "base_sales"
    GROUP BY "city_key"
),
"qualifying_cities" AS (
    SELECT
        "city_key"
    FROM "city_sales"
    WHERE "q4_2020_sales" >= "q4_2019_sales" * 1.20
      AND "q4_2020_sales" > "q4_2019_sales"
),
"qualified_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        bs."prod_id",
        bs."quarter_start",
        bs."amount_sold"
    FROM "base_sales" bs
    JOIN "qualifying_cities" qc
        ON bs."city_key" = qc."city_key"
),
"product_overall_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        SUM("amount_sold") AS "overall_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY "prod_id"
),
"ranked_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "overall_sales",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "overall_sales" DESC, "prod_id" ASC) AS "sales_rank",
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS "product_count"
    FROM "product_overall_sales"
),
"top_products" AS (
    SELECT
        rp."prod_id",
        pd."prod_name"
    FROM "ranked_products" rp
    JOIN "product_dim" pd
        ON rp."prod_id" = pd."prod_id"
    WHERE rp."sales_rank" <= CEIL(rp."product_count" * 0.20)
),
"quarter_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        "quarter_start",
        SUM("amount_sold") AS "quarter_total_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY "quarter_start"
),
"product_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "quarter_start",
        SUM("amount_sold") AS "product_quarter_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "prod_id",
        "quarter_start"
),
"quarters" AS (
    SELECT DATE '2019-10-01' AS "quarter_start"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2020-10-01' AS "quarter_start"
),
"product_quarter_shares" AS (
    SELECT
        tp."prod_id",
        tp."prod_name",
        q."quarter_start",
        COALESCE(pqs."product_quarter_sales", 0) / NULLIF(qt."quarter_total_sales", 0) AS "sales_share"
    FROM "top_products" tp
    CROSS JOIN "quarters" q
    LEFT JOIN "quarter_totals" qt
        ON q."quarter_start" = qt."quarter_start"
    LEFT JOIN "product_quarter_sales" pqs
        ON tp."prod_id" = pqs."prod_id"
       AND q."quarter_start" = pqs."quarter_start"
)
SELECT
    "prod_id",
    "prod_name",
    ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "sales_share" END), 0), 4) AS "q4_2019_share",
    ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN "sales_share" END), 0), 4) AS "q4_2020_share",
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN "sales_share" END), 0)
        - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "sales_share" END), 0),
        4
    ) AS "share_change"
FROM "product_quarter_shares"
GROUP BY
    "prod_id",
    "prod_name"
ORDER BY
    "share_change" DESC NULLS LAST,
    "prod_id" ASC;

        "city_key",
        3 AS "priority"
    FROM "us_customer_rows"
),
"us_customers" AS (
    SELECT
        "cust_id",
        "city_key"
    FROM "customer_id_candidates"
    WHERE "cust_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "city_key" IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "cust_id"
        ORDER BY "priority" ASC, "city_key" ASC
    ) = 1
),
"base_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        uc."city_key",
        s."prod_id",
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE(s."time_id", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "quarter_start",
        s."amount_sold" AS "amount_sold"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s
    JOIN "us_customers" uc
        ON s."cust_id" = uc."cust_id"
    LEFT JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PROMOTIONS pr
        ON s."promo_id" = pr."promo_id"
    WHERE (
            s."time_id" BETWEEN '20191001' AND '20191231'
         OR s."time_id" BETWEEN '20201001' AND '20201231'
    )
      AND (
            s."promo_id" IS NULL
         OR s."promo_id" IN (0, 999)
         OR UPPER(COALESCE(pr."promo_name", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROM%'
         OR UPPER(COALESCE(pr."promo_subcategory", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROM%'
         OR UPPER(COALESCE(pr."promo_category", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROM%'
         OR UPPER(COALESCE(pr."promo_total", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROM%'
      )
),
"city_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "city_key",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "amount_sold" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2019_sales",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN "amount_sold" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2020_sales"
    FROM "base_sales"
    GROUP BY "city_key"
),
"qualifying_cities" AS (
    SELECT
        "city_key"
    FROM "city_sales"
    WHERE "q4_2020_sales" >= "q4_2019_sales" * 1.20
      AND "q4_2020_sales" > "q4_2019_sales"
),
"qualified_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        bs."prod_id",
        bs."quarter_start",
        bs."amount_sold"
    FROM "base_sales" bs
    JOIN "qualifying_cities" qc
        ON bs."city_key" = qc."city_key"
),
"product_overall_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        SUM("amount_sold") AS "overall_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY "prod_id"
),
"ranked_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "overall_sales",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "overall_sales" DESC, "prod_id" ASC) AS "sales_rank",
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS "product_count"
    FROM "product_overall_sales"
),
"top_products" AS (
    SELECT
        rp."prod_id",
        pd."prod_name"
    FROM "ranked_products" rp
    JOIN "product_dim" pd
        ON rp."prod_id" = pd."prod_id"
    WHERE rp."sales_rank" <= CEIL(rp."product_count" * 0.20)
),
"quarter_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        "quarter_start",
        SUM("amount_sold") AS "quarter_total_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY "quarter_start"
),
"product_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "quarter_start",
        SUM("amount_sold") AS "product_quarter_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "prod_id",
        "quarter_start"
),
"quarters" AS (
    SELECT DATE '2019-10-01' AS "quarter_start"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DATE '2020-10-01' AS "quarter_start"
),
"product_quarter_shares" AS (
    SELECT
        tp."prod_id",
        tp."prod_name",
        q."quarter_start",
        COALESCE(pqs."product_quarter_sales", 0) / NULLIF(qt."quarter_total_sales", 0) AS "sales_share"
    FROM "top_products" tp
    CROSS JOIN "quarters" q
    LEFT JOIN "quarter_totals" qt
        ON q."quarter_start" = qt."quarter_start"
    LEFT JOIN "product_quarter_sales" pqs
        ON tp."prod_id" = pqs."prod_id"
       AND q."quarter_start" = pqs."quarter_start"
)
SELECT
    "prod_id",
    "prod_name",
    ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "sales_share" END), 0), 4) AS "q4_2019_share",
    ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN "sales_share" END), 0), 4) AS "q4_2020_share",
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN "sales_share" END), 0)
        - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "sales_share" END), 0),
        4
    ) AS "share_change"
FROM "product_quarter_shares"
GROUP BY
    "prod_id",
    "prod_name"
ORDER BY
    "share_change" DESC NULLS LAST,
    "prod_id" ASC;

"base_sales" AS (

        )

        )
    GROUP BY

            >= 1.20 * SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE('20191001', 'YYYYMMDD')) THEN "city_sales" ELSE 0 END)
),
"filtered_sales" AS (

        "bs"."prod_id",

    JOIN "qualifying_cities" AS "qc"

"product_overall_sales" AS (

),
"ranked_products" AS (

        "overall_sales",

"top_products" AS (

"product_quarter_sales" AS (

"quarter_totals" AS (

"product_names" AS (

),
"product_shares" AS (
    SELECT
        "tp"."prod_id",
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "pqs"."quarter_start" = DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE('20191001', 'YYYYMMDD')) THEN "pqs"."product_sales" ELSE 0 END), 0)
            / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN "qt"."quarter_start" = DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE('20191001', 'YYYYMMDD')) THEN "qt"."quarter_sales" END), 0) AS "q4_2019_share",

    CROSS JOIN "quarter_totals" AS "qt"

)
SELECT
    "ps"."prod_id",
    "pn"."prod_name",
    ROUND(COALESCE("ps"."q4_2019_share", 0), 4) AS "q4_2019_share",

    ROUND(COALESCE("ps"."q4_2020_share", 0) - COALESCE("ps"."q4_2019_share", 0), 4) AS "share_change"
FROM "product_shares" AS "ps"
LEFT JOIN "product_names" AS "pn"
    ON "ps"."prod_id" = "pn"."prod_id"
ORDER BY
    "share_change" DESC,
    "ps"."prod_id" ASC;

       OR UPPER(TRIM("promo_subcategory")) LIKE '%NO PROMOTION%'
       OR UPPER(TRIM("promo_subcategory")) LIKE '%NO PROMO%'
),
"us_customers" AS (

        'MD','MA','MI','MN','MS','MO','MT','NE','NV','NH','NJ','NM','NY','NC','ND','OH','OK','OR','PA','RI',
        'SC','SD','TN','TX','UT','VT','VA','WA','WV','WI','WY',

        'DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA','FLORIDA','GEORGIA','HAWAII','IDAHO','ILLINOIS','INDIANA','IOWA','KANSAS',
        'KENTUCKY','LOUISIANA','MAINE','MARYLAND','MASSACHUSETTS','MICHIGAN','MINNESOTA','MISSISSIPPI',
        'MISSOURI','MONTANA','NEBRASKA','NEVADA','NEW HAMPSHIRE','NEW JERSEY','NEW MEXICO','NEW YORK',
        'NORTH CAROLINA','NORTH DAKOTA','OHIO','OKLAHOMA','OREGON','PENNSYLVANIA','RHODE ISLAND',

"base_sales" AS (

        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE(s."time_id", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "quarter_start_date",

    FROM "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."SALES" s

    JOIN "COMPLEX_ORACLE"."COMPLEX_ORACLE"."PRODUCTS" p
        ON s."prod_id" = p."prod_id"

),

        "cust_city",

),

        bs."prod_name",

"final_shares" AS (

    LEFT JOIN "product_quarter_sales" pqs
        ON tp."prod_id" = pqs."prod_id"
       AND qt."quarter_start_date" = pqs."quarter_start_date"
    GROUP BY
        tp."prod_id",
        tp."prod_name",
        tp."overall_sales"
)
SELECT

    "prod_name",
    ROUND("q4_2019_share", 4) AS "q4_2019_share",
    ROUND("q4_2020_share", 4) AS "q4_2020_share",

WITH "no_promotion_ids" AS (

        "p"."promo_id" AS "promo_id"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PROMOTIONS AS "p"
    WHERE "p"."promo_id" = 999
       OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("p"."promo_name", ''))) LIKE '%NO%PROMOTION%'
       OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("p"."promo_category", ''))) LIKE '%NO%PROMOTION%'
       OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("p"."promo_subcategory", ''))) LIKE '%NO%PROMOTION%'
       OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("p"."promo_total", ''))) LIKE '%NO%PROMOTION%'
),
"us_customer_candidates" AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            TRY_TO_NUMBER(TRIM("c"."cust_src_id")),
            TRY_TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR("c"."cust_src_id", '[0-9]+'))
        ) AS "cust_id",
        COALESCE(TO_VARCHAR("c"."cust_city_id"), UPPER(TRIM("c"."cust_city"))) AS "city_key",
        "c"."cust_eff_to" AS "cust_eff_to"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.CUSTOMERS AS "c"
    WHERE "c"."cust_city" IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(
            TRY_TO_NUMBER(TRIM("c"."cust_src_id")),
            TRY_TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR("c"."cust_src_id", '[0-9]+'))
          ) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
            REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("c"."cust_state_province", ''))), '(^|[^A-Z])(AL|AK|AZ|AR|CA|CO|CT|DE|DC|FL|GA|HI|ID|IL|IN|IA|KS|KY|LA|ME|MD|MA|MI|MN|MS|MO|MT|NE|NV|NH|NJ|NM|NY|NC|ND|OH|OK|OR|PA|RI|SC|SD|TN|TX|UT|VT|VA|WA|WV|WI|WY)([^A-Z]|$)')
         OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("c"."cust_state_province", ''))) LIKE '%ALABAMA%'
         OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("c"."cust_state_province", ''))) LIKE '%ALASKA%'
         OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("c"."cust_state_province", ''))) LIKE '%ARIZONA%'
         OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("c"."cust_state_province", ''))) LIKE '%ARKANSAS%'
         OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("c"."cust_state_province", ''))) LIKE '%CALIFORNIA%'
         OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE("c"."cust_state_province", ''))) LIKE '%COLORADO%'

"us_customers" AS (
    SELECT
        "ucc"."cust_id" AS "cust_id",
        "ucc"."city_key" AS "city_key"
    FROM "us_customer_candidates" AS "ucc"
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "ucc"."cust_id"
        ORDER BY "ucc"."cust_eff_to" DESC NULLS LAST, "ucc"."city_key" ASC
    ) = 1
),
"product_dim" AS (
    SELECT
        "p"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        "p"."prod_name" AS "prod_name"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PRODUCTS AS "p"
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "p"."prod_id"
        ORDER BY "p"."prod_eff_to" DESC NULLS LAST, "p"."prod_name" ASC
    ) = 1
),
"base_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "uc"."city_key" AS "city_key",
        "s"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE("s"."time_id", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "quarter_start",
        "s"."amount_sold" AS "sales_amount"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES AS "s"
    JOIN "us_customers" AS "uc"
        ON "s"."cust_id" = "uc"."cust_id"
    JOIN "no_promotion_ids" AS "npi"
        ON "s"."promo_id" = "npi"."promo_id"
    WHERE (
            "s"."time_id" BETWEEN '20191001' AND '20191231'
         OR "s"."time_id" BETWEEN '20201001' AND '20201231'
      )
),
"city_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "bs"."city_key" AS "city_key",
        "bs"."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        SUM("bs"."sales_amount") AS "city_sales"
    FROM "base_sales" AS "bs"
    GROUP BY
        "bs"."city_key",
        "bs"."quarter_start"
),
"qualifying_cities" AS (
    SELECT
        "cqs"."city_key" AS "city_key"
    FROM "city_quarter_sales" AS "cqs"
    GROUP BY
        "cqs"."city_key"
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN "cqs"."quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "cqs"."city_sales" ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN "cqs"."quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN "cqs"."city_sales" ELSE 0 END)
           >= 1.2 * SUM(CASE WHEN "cqs"."quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "cqs"."city_sales" ELSE 0 END)
),
"filtered_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "bs"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        "bs"."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        "bs"."sales_amount" AS "sales_amount"
    FROM "base_sales" AS "bs"
    JOIN "qualifying_cities" AS "qc"
        ON "bs"."city_key" = "qc"."city_key"
),
"product_overall_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "fs"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        SUM("fs"."sales_amount") AS "overall_sales"
    FROM "filtered_sales" AS "fs"
    GROUP BY
        "fs"."prod_id"
),
"ranked_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "pos"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "pos"."overall_sales" DESC NULLS LAST, "pos"."prod_id" ASC) AS "product_rank",
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS "product_count"
    FROM "product_overall_sales" AS "pos"
),
"top_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "rp"."prod_id" AS "prod_id"
    FROM "ranked_products" AS "rp"
    WHERE "rp"."product_rank" <= GREATEST(1, CEIL("rp"."product_count" * 0.2))
),
"quarter_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        "fs"."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        SUM("fs"."sales_amount") AS "quarter_sales"
    FROM "filtered_sales" AS "fs"
    GROUP BY
        "fs"."quarter_start"
),
"product_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "fs"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        "fs"."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        SUM("fs"."sales_amount") AS "product_sales"
    FROM "filtered_sales" AS "fs"
    GROUP BY
        "fs"."prod_id",
        "fs"."quarter_start"
),
"product_shares" AS (
    SELECT
        "pqs"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        "pqs"."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        "pqs"."product_sales" / NULLIF("qt"."quarter_sales", 0) AS "sales_share"
    FROM "product_quarter_sales" AS "pqs"
    JOIN "quarter_totals" AS "qt"
        ON "pqs"."quarter_start" = "qt"."quarter_start"
)
SELECT
    "tp"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
    "pd"."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
    ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "ps"."sales_share" END), 0), 4) AS "q4_2019_share",
    ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN "ps"."sales_share" END), 0), 4) AS "q4_2020_share",
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01' THEN "ps"."sales_share" END), 0)
        - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01' THEN "ps"."sales_share" END), 0),
        4
    ) AS "share_change"
FROM "top_products" AS "tp"
LEFT JOIN "product_dim" AS "pd"
    ON "tp"."prod_id" = "pd"."prod_id"
LEFT JOIN "product_shares" AS "ps"
    ON "tp"."prod_id" = "ps"."prod_id"
GROUP BY
    "tp"."prod_id",
    "pd"."prod_name"
ORDER BY
    "share_change" DESC NULLS LAST,
    "prod_id" ASC;

"no_promotion_ids" AS (

        OR UPPER(COALESCE(p."promo_category", '')) LIKE '%NO PROMO%'
        OR UPPER(COALESCE(p."promo_subcategory", '')) LIKE '%NO PROMO%'
        OR UPPER(COALESCE(p."promo_total", '')) LIKE '%NO PROMO%'
        OR p."promo_id" = 999
),
"base_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        u."cust_city_id" AS "cust_city_id",
        u."cust_city" AS "cust_city",
        s."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE(s."time_id", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "quarter_start",
        s."amount_sold" AS "sales_amount"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s
    JOIN "us_customer_keys" u
        ON s."cust_id" = u."cust_id"
    LEFT JOIN "no_promotion_ids" n
        ON s."promo_id" = n."promo_id"
    WHERE (
            s."time_id" BETWEEN '20191001' AND '20191231'
            OR s."time_id" BETWEEN '20201001' AND '20201231'
        )
        AND (
            s."promo_id" IS NULL
            OR s."promo_id" IN (0, 999)
            OR n."promo_id" IS NOT NULL
        )
),
"city_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "cust_city_id",
        "cust_city",
        SUM(IFF("quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01', "sales_amount", 0)) AS "q4_2019_sales",
        SUM(IFF("quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01', "sales_amount", 0)) AS "q4_2020_sales"
    FROM "base_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "cust_city_id",
        "cust_city"
),
"qualifying_cities" AS (
    SELECT
        "cust_city_id",
        "cust_city"
    FROM "city_sales"
    WHERE "q4_2019_sales" > 0
        AND "q4_2020_sales" >= "q4_2019_sales" * 1.20
),
"qualified_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        b."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        b."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        b."sales_amount" AS "sales_amount"
    FROM "base_sales" b
    JOIN "qualifying_cities" q
        ON b."cust_city_id" = q."cust_city_id"
        AND b."cust_city" = q."cust_city"
),
"product_overall_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        SUM("sales_amount") AS "overall_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "prod_id"
),
"ranked_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "overall_sales",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "overall_sales" DESC, "prod_id" ASC) AS "product_rank",
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS "product_count"
    FROM "product_overall_sales"
),
"top_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "overall_sales"
    FROM "ranked_products"
    WHERE "product_rank" <= GREATEST(1, CEIL("product_count" * 0.20))
),
"quarter_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        "quarter_start",
        SUM("sales_amount") AS "total_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "quarter_start"
),
"product_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "quarter_start",
        SUM("sales_amount") AS "product_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "prod_id",
        "quarter_start"
),
"product_names" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        MIN("prod_name") AS "prod_name"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PRODUCTS
    GROUP BY
        "prod_id"
),
"product_shares" AS (
    SELECT
        t."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        pn."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
        t."overall_sales" AS "overall_sales",
        SUM(IFF(qt."quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01', COALESCE(pq."product_sales", 0), 0))
            / NULLIF(MAX(IFF(qt."quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01', qt."total_sales", NULL)), 0) AS "q4_2019_share",
        SUM(IFF(qt."quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01', COALESCE(pq."product_sales", 0), 0))
            / NULLIF(MAX(IFF(qt."quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01', qt."total_sales", NULL)), 0) AS "q4_2020_share"
    FROM "top_products" t
    JOIN "product_names" pn
        ON t."prod_id" = pn."prod_id"
    CROSS JOIN "quarter_totals" qt
    LEFT JOIN "product_quarter_sales" pq
        ON t."prod_id" = pq."prod_id"
        AND qt."quarter_start" = pq."quarter_start"
    GROUP BY
        t."prod_id",
        pn."prod_name",
        t."overall_sales"
)
SELECT
    "prod_id",
    "prod_name",
    ROUND(COALESCE("q4_2019_share", 0), 4) AS "q4_2019_share",
    ROUND(COALESCE("q4_2020_share", 0), 4) AS "q4_2020_share",
    ROUND(COALESCE("q4_2020_share", 0) - COALESCE("q4_2019_share", 0), 4) AS "share_change"
FROM "product_shares"
ORDER BY
    "share_change" DESC,
    "overall_sales" DESC,
    "prod_id" ASC;

  WHERE ("s"."time_id" BETWEEN '20191001' AND '20191231'
      OR "s"."time_id" BETWEEN '20201001' AND '20201231')
    AND ("s"."promo_id" = 999 OR "np"."promo_id" IS NOT NULL)
),
"city_quarter_sales" AS (
  SELECT
    "cust_city_id",
    "cust_city",
    "cust_state_province",
    "quarter_start",
    SUM("sales_amount") AS "city_sales"
  FROM "base_sales"
  GROUP BY
    "cust_city_id",
    "cust_city",
    "cust_state_province",
    "quarter_start"
),
"qualifying_cities" AS (
  SELECT
    "cust_city_id",
    "cust_city",
    "cust_state_province"
  FROM "city_quarter_sales"
  GROUP BY
    "cust_city_id",
    "cust_city",
    "cust_state_province"
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20191001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "city_sales" ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20201001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "city_sales" ELSE 0 END)
       >= 1.2 * SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20191001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "city_sales" ELSE 0 END)
),
"selected_city_sales" AS (
  SELECT
    "b"."prod_id",
    "b"."quarter_start",
    "b"."sales_amount"
  FROM "base_sales" AS "b"
  JOIN "qualifying_cities" AS "qc"
    ON "b"."cust_city_id" = "qc"."cust_city_id"
   AND "b"."cust_city" = "qc"."cust_city"
   AND "b"."cust_state_province" = "qc"."cust_state_province"
),
"product_overall_sales" AS (
  SELECT
    "prod_id",
    SUM("sales_amount") AS "overall_sales"
  FROM "selected_city_sales"
  GROUP BY
    "prod_id"
),
"ranked_products" AS (
  SELECT
    "prod_id",
    "overall_sales",
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "overall_sales" DESC) AS "sales_rank",
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS "product_count"
  FROM "product_overall_sales"
),
"top_products" AS (
  SELECT
    "prod_id"
  FROM "ranked_products"
  WHERE "sales_rank" <= CEIL("product_count" * 0.20)
),
"quarter_totals" AS (
  SELECT
    "quarter_start",
    SUM("sales_amount") AS "quarter_total_sales"
  FROM "selected_city_sales"
  GROUP BY
    "quarter_start"
),
"product_quarter_sales" AS (
  SELECT
    "tp"."prod_id",
    "scs"."quarter_start",
    SUM("scs"."sales_amount") AS "product_sales"
  FROM "top_products" AS "tp"
  JOIN "selected_city_sales" AS "scs"
    ON "tp"."prod_id" = "scs"."prod_id"
  GROUP BY
    "tp"."prod_id",
    "scs"."quarter_start"
),
"product_shares" AS (
  SELECT
    "pqs"."prod_id",
    "pqs"."quarter_start",
    "pqs"."product_sales" / NULLIF("qt"."quarter_total_sales", 0) AS "product_share"
  FROM "product_quarter_sales" AS "pqs"
  JOIN "quarter_totals" AS "qt"
    ON "pqs"."quarter_start" = "qt"."quarter_start"
)
SELECT
  "tp"."prod_id",
  "pd"."prod_name",
  ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20191001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "ps"."product_share" END), 0), 4) AS "q4_2019_share",
  ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20201001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "ps"."product_share" END), 0), 4) AS "q4_2020_share",
  ROUND(
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20201001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "ps"."product_share" END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20191001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "ps"."product_share" END), 0),
    4
  ) AS "share_change"
FROM "top_products" AS "tp"
LEFT JOIN "product_dim" AS "pd"
  ON "tp"."prod_id" = "pd"."prod_id"
LEFT JOIN "product_shares" AS "ps"
  ON "tp"."prod_id" = "ps"."prod_id"
GROUP BY
  "tp"."prod_id",
  "pd"."prod_name"
ORDER BY
  "share_change" DESC NULLS LAST,
  "tp"."prod_id" ASC;

WITH "no_promotion_ids" AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        "promo_id"
    FROM (
        SELECT
            "promo_id"
        FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PROMOTIONS
        WHERE "promo_id" = 999
            OR UPPER(TRIM("promo_name")) LIKE '%NO%PROMO%'
            OR UPPER(TRIM("promo_category")) LIKE '%NO%PROMO%'
            OR UPPER(TRIM("promo_subcategory")) LIKE '%NO%PROMO%'
            OR UPPER(TRIM("promo_total")) LIKE '%NO%PROMO%'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            999 AS "promo_id"
    )
),
"customer_rows" AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE("cust_src_id", '[^0-9]', ''), '') AS "source_digits",
        TRY_TO_NUMBER(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE("cust_src_id", '[^0-9]', ''), '')) AS "source_number",
        "cust_src_id" AS "cust_src_id",
        TRIM("cust_city") AS "city_name",
        UPPER(TRIM("cust_state_province")) AS "state_province",
        UPPER(TRIM("cust_total")) AS "cust_total"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.CUSTOMERS
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "cust_src_id"
        ORDER BY "cust_eff_from" DESC NULLS LAST, "cust_eff_to" DESC NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
),
"customer_map_candidates" AS (
    SELECT
        'SOURCE_NUMBER' AS "mapping_type",
        "source_number" AS "cust_id",
        "city_name",
        "state_province",
        "cust_total",
        1 AS "mapping_priority"
    FROM "customer_rows"
    WHERE "source_number" IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'ROW_NUMBER' AS "mapping_type",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY "source_number" ASC NULLS LAST, "cust_src_id" ASC NULLS LAST, "city_name" ASC NULLS LAST, "state_province" ASC NULLS LAST
        ) AS "cust_id",
        "city_name",
        "state_province",
        "cust_total",
        2 AS "mapping_priority"
    FROM "customer_rows"
),
"customer_maps" AS (
    SELECT
        "mapping_type",
        "cust_id",
        "city_name",
        "state_province",
        "cust_total",
        "mapping_priority"
    FROM "customer_map_candidates"
    WHERE "cust_id" IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "mapping_type", "cust_id"
        ORDER BY "mapping_priority" ASC, "city_name" ASC NULLS LAST, "state_province" ASC NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
),
"mapping_counts" AS (
    SELECT
        "m"."mapping_type",
        COUNT(*) AS "matched_sales_count"
    FROM "customer_maps" AS "m"
    JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES AS "s"
        ON "s"."cust_id" = "m"."cust_id"
    LEFT JOIN "no_promotion_ids" AS "np"
        ON "np"."promo_id" = "s"."promo_id"
    WHERE (
            ("s"."time_id" >= '20191001' AND "s"."time_id" < '20200101')
            OR ("s"."time_id" >= '20201001' AND "s"."time_id" < '20210101')
        )
        AND ("s"."promo_id" IS NULL OR "np"."promo_id" IS NOT NULL)
    GROUP BY
        "m"."mapping_type"
),
"best_mapping" AS (
    SELECT
        "mapping_type"
    FROM "mapping_counts"
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY "matched_sales_count" DESC, "mapping_type" ASC
    ) = 1
),
"customer_dim" AS (
    SELECT
        "m"."cust_id",
        "m"."city_name",
        "m"."state_province"
    FROM "customer_maps" AS "m"
    JOIN "best_mapping" AS "b"
        ON "b"."mapping_type" = "m"."mapping_type"
    WHERE "m"."city_name" IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            "m"."state_province" IN (
                'AL', 'ALABAMA', 'AK', 'ALASKA', 'AZ', 'ARIZONA', 'AR', 'ARKANSAS',
                'CA', 'CALIFORNIA', 'CO', 'COLORADO', 'CT', 'CONNECTICUT',
                'DE', 'DELAWARE', 'DC', 'DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA', 'FL', 'FLORIDA',
                'GA', 'GEORGIA', 'HI', 'HAWAII', 'ID', 'IDAHO', 'IL', 'ILLINOIS',
                'IN', 'INDIANA', 'IA', 'IOWA', 'KS', 'KANSAS', 'KY', 'KENTUCKY',
                'LA', 'LOUISIANA', 'ME', 'MAINE', 'MD', 'MARYLAND',
                'MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS', 'MI', 'MICHIGAN', 'MN', 'MINNESOTA',
                'MS', 'MISSISSIPPI', 'MO', 'MISSOURI', 'MT', 'MONTANA',
                'NE', 'NEBRASKA', 'NV', 'NEVADA', 'NH', 'NEW HAMPSHIRE',
                'NJ', 'NEW JERSEY', 'NM', 'NEW MEXICO', 'NY', 'NEW YORK',
                'NC', 'NORTH CAROLINA', 'ND', 'NORTH DAKOTA', 'OH', 'OHIO',
                'OK', 'OKLAHOMA', 'OR', 'OREGON', 'PA', 'PENNSYLVANIA',
                'RI', 'RHODE ISLAND', 'SC', 'SOUTH CAROLINA', 'SD', 'SOUTH DAKOTA',
                'TN', 'TENNESSEE', 'TX', 'TEXAS', 'UT', 'UTAH', 'VT', 'VERMONT',
                'VA', 'VIRGINIA', 'WA', 'WASHINGTON', 'WV', 'WEST VIRGINIA',
                'WI', 'WISCONSIN', 'WY', 'WYOMING',
                'US', 'USA', 'UNITED STATES', 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA'
            )
            OR "m"."cust_total" IN ('US', 'USA', 'UNITED STATES', 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA')
        )
),
"product_dim" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "prod_name"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PRODUCTS
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "prod_id"
        ORDER BY "prod_eff_from" DESC NULLS LAST, "prod_eff_to" DESC NULLS LAST
    ) = 1
),
"base_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "c"."state_province",
        "c"."city_name",
        "p"."prod_id",
        "p"."prod_name",
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE("s"."time_id", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "quarter_start",
        COALESCE("s"."amount_sold", 0) AS "sales_amount"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES AS "s"
    JOIN "customer_dim" AS "c"
        ON "c"."cust_id" = "s"."cust_id"
    JOIN "product_dim" AS "p"
        ON "p"."prod_id" = "s"."prod_id"
    LEFT JOIN "no_promotion_ids" AS "np"
        ON "np"."promo_id" = "s"."promo_id"
    WHERE (
            ("s"."time_id" >= '20191001' AND "s"."time_id" < '20200101')
            OR ("s"."time_id" >= '20201001' AND "s"."time_id" < '20210101')
        )
        AND ("s"."promo_id" IS NULL OR "np"."promo_id" IS NOT NULL)
),
"city_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "state_province",
        "city_name",
        "quarter_start",
        SUM("sales_amount") AS "city_sales"
    FROM "base_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "state_province",
        "city_name",
        "quarter_start"
),
"qualifying_cities" AS (
    SELECT
        "state_province",
        "city_name"
    FROM "city_quarter_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "state_province",
        "city_name"
    HAVING SUM(IFF("quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01', "city_sales", 0)) > 0
        AND SUM(IFF("quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01', "city_sales", 0))
            >= 1.20 * SUM(IFF("quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01', "city_sales", 0))
),
"qualified_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "b"."prod_id",
        "b"."prod_name",
        "b"."quarter_start",
        "b"."sales_amount"
    FROM "base_sales" AS "b"
    JOIN "qualifying_cities" AS "q"
        ON "q"."state_province" = "b"."state_province"
        AND "q"."city_name" = "b"."city_name"
),
"product_overall_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "prod_name",
        SUM("sales_amount") AS "overall_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "prod_id",
        "prod_name"
),
"ranked_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "prod_name",
        "overall_sales",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "overall_sales" DESC, "prod_id" ASC) AS "product_rank",
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS "product_count"
    FROM "product_overall_sales"
),
"top_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "prod_name"
    FROM "ranked_products"
    WHERE "product_rank" <= CEIL("product_count" * 0.20)
),
"quarter_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(IFF("quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01', "sales_amount", 0)) AS "q4_2019_total_sales",
        SUM(IFF("quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01', "sales_amount", 0)) AS "q4_2020_total_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
),
"product_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "tp"."prod_id",
        "tp"."prod_name",
        SUM(IFF("qs"."quarter_start" = DATE '2019-10-01', "qs"."sales_amount", 0)) AS "q4_2019_product_sales",
        SUM(IFF("qs"."quarter_start" = DATE '2020-10-01', "qs"."sales_amount", 0)) AS "q4_2020_product_sales"
    FROM "top_products" AS "tp"
    LEFT JOIN "qualified_sales" AS "qs"
        ON "qs"."prod_id" = "tp"."prod_id"
    GROUP BY
        "tp"."prod_id",
        "tp"."prod_name"
),
"product_shares" AS (
    SELECT
        "pqs"."prod_id",
        "pqs"."prod_name",
        "pqs"."q4_2019_product_sales" / NULLIF("qt"."q4_2019_total_sales", 0) AS "q4_2019_share",
        "pqs"."q4_2020_product_sales" / NULLIF("qt"."q4_2020_total_sales", 0) AS "q4_2020_share"
    FROM "product_quarter_sales" AS "pqs"
    CROSS JOIN "quarter_totals" AS "qt"
)
SELECT
    "prod_id" AS "product_id",
    "prod_name" AS "product_name",
    ROUND(COALESCE("q4_2019_share", 0), 4) AS "q4_2019_share",
    ROUND(COALESCE("q4_2020_share", 0), 4) AS "q4_2020_share",
    ROUND(COALESCE("q4_2020_share", 0) - COALESCE("q4_2019_share", 0), 4) AS "share_change"
FROM "product_shares"
ORDER BY
    "share_change" DESC,
    "product_id" ASC;

WITH "customer_dates" AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_TO_NUMBER("cust_src_id") AS "cust_id",
        "cust_city" AS "city",
        "cust_state_province" AS "state_province",
        COALESCE(
            TRY_TO_DATE("cust_eff_from", 'YYYYMMDD'),
            TRY_TO_DATE("cust_eff_from", 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
            TRY_TO_DATE("cust_eff_from")
        ) AS "cust_eff_from_date",
        COALESCE(
            TRY_TO_DATE("cust_eff_to", 'YYYYMMDD'),
            TRY_TO_DATE("cust_eff_to", 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
            TRY_TO_DATE("cust_eff_to")
        ) AS "cust_eff_to_date"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.CUSTOMERS
    WHERE TRY_TO_NUMBER("cust_src_id") IS NOT NULL
        AND "cust_city" IS NOT NULL
        AND UPPER("cust_state_province") IN (
            'AL', 'ALABAMA', 'AK', 'ALASKA', 'AZ', 'ARIZONA', 'AR', 'ARKANSAS',
            'CA', 'CALIFORNIA', 'CO', 'COLORADO', 'CT', 'CONNECTICUT', 'DE', 'DELAWARE',
            'DC', 'DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA', 'FL', 'FLORIDA', 'GA', 'GEORGIA', 'HI', 'HAWAII',
            'ID', 'IDAHO', 'IL', 'ILLINOIS', 'IN', 'INDIANA', 'IA', 'IOWA', 'KS', 'KANSAS',
            'KY', 'KENTUCKY', 'LA', 'LOUISIANA', 'ME', 'MAINE', 'MD', 'MARYLAND',
            'MA', 'MASSACHUSETTS', 'MI', 'MICHIGAN', 'MN', 'MINNESOTA', 'MS', 'MISSISSIPPI',
            'MO', 'MISSOURI', 'MT', 'MONTANA', 'NE', 'NEBRASKA', 'NV', 'NEVADA',
            'NH', 'NEW HAMPSHIRE', 'NJ', 'NEW JERSEY', 'NM', 'NEW MEXICO', 'NY', 'NEW YORK',
            'NC', 'NORTH CAROLINA', 'ND', 'NORTH DAKOTA', 'OH', 'OHIO', 'OK', 'OKLAHOMA',
            'OR', 'OREGON', 'PA', 'PENNSYLVANIA', 'RI', 'RHODE ISLAND',
            'SC', 'SOUTH CAROLINA', 'SD', 'SOUTH DAKOTA', 'TN', 'TENNESSEE',
            'TX', 'TEXAS', 'UT', 'UTAH', 'VT', 'VERMONT', 'VA', 'VIRGINIA',
            'WA', 'WASHINGTON', 'WV', 'WEST VIRGINIA', 'WI', 'WISCONSIN', 'WY', 'WYOMING'
        )
),
"no_promotion_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE("s"."time_id", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "quarter_start",
        "c"."city" AS "city",
        "s"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        SUM("s"."amount_sold") AS "sales"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES AS "s"
    JOIN "customer_dates" AS "c"
        ON "s"."cust_id" = "c"."cust_id"
        AND (
            "c"."cust_eff_from_date" IS NULL
            OR "c"."cust_eff_from_date" <= TO_DATE("s"."time_id", 'YYYYMMDD')
        )
        AND (
            "c"."cust_eff_to_date" IS NULL
            OR "c"."cust_eff_to_date" >= TO_DATE("s"."time_id", 'YYYYMMDD')
        )
    LEFT JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PROMOTIONS AS "p"
        ON "s"."promo_id" = "p"."promo_id"
    WHERE (
            "s"."time_id" BETWEEN '20191001' AND '20191231'
            OR "s"."time_id" BETWEEN '20201001' AND '20201231'
        )
        AND (
            "s"."promo_id" IS NULL
            OR "s"."promo_id" = 999
            OR UPPER(COALESCE("p"."promo_name", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROMO%'
            OR UPPER(COALESCE("p"."promo_category", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROMO%'
            OR UPPER(COALESCE("p"."promo_subcategory", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROMO%'
            OR UPPER(COALESCE("p"."promo_total", '')) LIKE '%NO%PROMO%'
        )
    GROUP BY
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', TO_DATE("s"."time_id", 'YYYYMMDD')),
        "c"."city",
        "s"."prod_id"
),
"city_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "city",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20191001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "sales" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2019_sales",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20201001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "sales" ELSE 0 END) AS "q4_2020_sales"
    FROM "no_promotion_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "city"
),
"qualifying_cities" AS (
    SELECT
        "city"
    FROM "city_sales"
    WHERE "q4_2019_sales" > 0
        AND "q4_2020_sales" >= "q4_2019_sales" * 1.20
),
"qualified_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "nps"."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        "nps"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        SUM("nps"."sales") AS "sales"
    FROM "no_promotion_sales" AS "nps"
    JOIN "qualifying_cities" AS "qc"
        ON "nps"."city" = "qc"."city"
    GROUP BY
        "nps"."quarter_start",
        "nps"."prod_id"
),
"product_overall_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        SUM("sales") AS "overall_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "prod_id"
),
"ranked_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "overall_sales",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "overall_sales" DESC, "prod_id" ASC) AS "product_rank",
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS "product_count"
    FROM "product_overall_sales"
),
"top_products" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id"
    FROM "ranked_products"
    WHERE "product_rank" <= CEIL("product_count" * 0.20)
),
"quarter_totals" AS (
    SELECT
        "quarter_start",
        SUM("sales") AS "quarter_total_sales"
    FROM "qualified_sales"
    GROUP BY
        "quarter_start"
),
"top_product_quarter_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "tp"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
        "qt"."quarter_start" AS "quarter_start",
        COALESCE(SUM("qs"."sales"), 0) AS "product_quarter_sales",
        MAX("qt"."quarter_total_sales") AS "quarter_total_sales"
    FROM "top_products" AS "tp"
    CROSS JOIN "quarter_totals" AS "qt"
    LEFT JOIN "qualified_sales" AS "qs"
        ON "tp"."prod_id" = "qs"."prod_id"
        AND "qt"."quarter_start" = "qs"."quarter_start"
    GROUP BY
        "tp"."prod_id",
        "qt"."quarter_start"
),
"product_names" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "prod_name"
    FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.COMPLEX_ORACLE.PRODUCTS
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "prod_id"
        ORDER BY COALESCE("prod_eff_from", '') DESC, COALESCE("prod_eff_to", '') DESC, "prod_name" ASC
    ) = 1
),
"product_shares" AS (
    SELECT
        "prod_id",
        "quarter_start",
        "product_quarter_sales" / NULLIF("quarter_total_sales", 0) AS "sales_share"
    FROM "top_product_quarter_sales"
)
SELECT
    "ps"."prod_id" AS "prod_id",
    "pn"."prod_name" AS "prod_name",
    ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20191001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "ps"."sales_share" END), 0), 4) AS "q4_2019_share",
    ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20201001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "ps"."sales_share" END), 0), 4) AS "q4_2020_share",
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20201001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "ps"."sales_share" END), 0)
        - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN "ps"."quarter_start" = TO_DATE('20191001', 'YYYYMMDD') THEN "ps"."sales_share" END), 0),
        4
    ) AS "share_change"
FROM "product_shares" AS "ps"
LEFT JOIN "product_names" AS "pn"
    ON "ps"."prod_id" = "pn"."prod_id"
GROUP BY
    "ps"."prod_id",
    "pn"."prod_name"
ORDER BY
    "share_change" DESC,
    "prod_id" ASC;

WITH "season_team_wins" AS (
    SELECT
        "team_id",
        "name",
        "season",
        "wins"
    FROM NCAA_BASKETBALL.NCAA_BASKETBALL.MBB_HISTORICAL_TEAMS_SEASONS
    WHERE "season" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
      AND "name" IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM("name") <> ''
),
"season_max_wins" AS (
    SELECT
        "team_id",
        "name",
        "season",
        "wins",
        MAX("wins") OVER (PARTITION BY "season") AS "max_wins_for_season"
    FROM "season_team_wins"
),
"peak_seasons" AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        "team_id",
        "name",
        "season"
    FROM "season_max_wins"
    WHERE "wins" = "max_wins_for_season"
)
SELECT
